Frequency once per hour

Range 60 feet

Duration until your next daily preparations

Saving Throw Will

Name one creature you have personally witnessed commit an act your patron would judge. It attempts a Will save against your spell DC; on a failure it takes a −1 status penalty to all checks and saves for the duration, and on a critical failure −2. This has no effect on a creature that has not earned it — the GM is the judge of that, and a wrongly named target simply does not respond.
